∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ∀ (t : ℚ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.poleProduct n t = (t + ↑j) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j t
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ), (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) → ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.poleProduct n t ≠ 0
∀ (n j : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j) ≠ 0

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ∀ (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.actualR n t * (t + ↑j) ^ 9 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedR n j t

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t * (t + ↑j) ^ 9 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedWeightedR n j W t
∀ (a n : ℕ), ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (↑a + (↑i + 1)) = ↑n.factorial * ↑((a + n).choose n)
∀ (n : ℕ), ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (↑k - ↑n) = (-1) ^ n * ↑n.factorial
∀ (n j : ℕ), j ≤ n → ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j) = (-1) ^ j * ↑j.factorial * ↑(n - j).factorial

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n (-↑j) =
      (-1) ^ n * ↑n.factorial ^ 9 * ↑((n + j).choose n) * ↑((2 * n - j).choose n)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j =
      (-1) ^ (n + j) * ↑(n.choose j) ^ 9 * ↑((n + j).choose n) * ↑((2 * n - j).choose n)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  Even n →
    j ≤ n →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j =
        (-1) ^ j * ↑(n.choose j) ^ 9 * ↑((n + j).choose n) * ↑((2 * n - j).choose n)
∀ (n j : ℕ), j ≤ n → ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j ≠ 0
∀ (n j : ℕ), j ≤ n → ∃ z, ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j = ↑z
∀ (n j : ℕ), Even n → j ≤ n → (-1) ^ j * ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j > 0

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ) (z : ℚ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedWeightedR n j W (-↑j + z) =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedR n j (-↑j + z) * Polynomial.eval (-↑j * ↑(n - j) + (↑n - 2 * ↑j) * z + z ^ 2) W

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedLeadingPoleCoefficient n j W =
        (-1) ^ (n + j) * ↑(n.choose j) ^ 9 * ↑((n + j).choose n) * ↑((2 * n - j).choose n) *
          Polynomial.eval (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) W

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  Even n →
    j ≤ n →
      ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedLeadingPoleCoefficient n j W =
          (-1) ^ j * ↑(n.choose j) ^ 9 * ↑((n + j).choose n) * ↑((2 * n - j).choose n) *
            Polynomial.eval (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) W

∀ (n j : ℕ),
